lines.text: Boats from Tiberias landed nearby, and the crowd took them to Capernaum to look for Jesus.
The crowd said their fathers ate manna, and Jesus said not Elijah but His Father gives the true bread.
The Jews grumbled that they knew Jesus' father and mother, and asked how He came down from heaven.
Jesus said fathers who ate manna died but eaters of this bread live forever, teaching in the temple in Capernaum.
